t: This is St James' Church, Norlands, a Grade II listed Church of England church in Kensington. Construction was completed in 1845, and the church was consecrated on the seventeenth of July that year. It was designed by the architects Lewis Vulliamy and Robert Jewell Withers. Vulliamy came from the Vulliamy family of clockmakers, so there's a pleasing link between a family known for timekeeping and a building that has stood here since the mid nineteenth century. Look up at the architecture and the stonework as you stand here.
